literal: In the dark pupil / O image! you / go away, we / love / to the beautiful forehead / is not / space.
translation: O image in the dark pupil of my eye, please leave! There is no room for my beloved with the beautiful forehead whom I love.
modern: என் கண்ணின் கருமணியில் உள்ள பாவாய், நீ வெளியே போ! நான் விரும்பும் அழகிய நெற்றியை உடைய என் காதலி அங்கே இருக்க இடம் இல்லை.
explanation: The speaker playfully addresses the tiny reflection, or 'image', naturally seen in the dark pupil of the eye. He asks this image to step aside and leave to make space for his beloved. By claiming there is no room for both the reflection and the woman he loves, he poetically expresses the depth of his affection. His beloved occupies his entire vision and mind, leaving no space for anything else.
